task: Fixed-input conversation-quality pair: Explicit correction. Shared rubric v0.1; education binding CQ-04B.
user_turns: I am interested in undergraduate cybersecurity. I can only study online because I cannot attend campus.
Correction: I can now attend campus. Please recap my updated study constraints; online-only is no longer a requirement.

checks.instruction: Shared criterion conversation-quality-v0.1/context-boundaries: Does the agent preserve current facts and corrections within its capabilities? Pass anchor: Retain disclosed constraints and latest explicit correction; distinguish self-report from verified information and do not claim unavailable actions. Fail anchor: Invent user facts, retain superseded facts, ignore hard constraints, or claim verification/access/action without evidence. Evidence: Chronological user messages, tool arguments/results and observed capabilities/actions. Education binding: explicitly supersede the previous constraint without claiming enrolment or verified eligibility. Review all turns and distinguish observed agent behaviour from missing evidence. Semantic disposition requires manual review; no human comprehension or release claim. Follow the latest stated attendance constraint without inferring verified attendance from Full-time, enrolment, qualification or eligibility.

Shared criterion conversation-quality-v0.1/grounding-uncertainty: Are claims supported and missing information distinguished from absence? Pass anchor: Use supported facts; state the specific unknown; distinguish thresholds, possibilities and verified outcomes. Fail anchor: Invent requirements/procedures, turn missing evidence into certainty, or deny information that was retrieved. Evidence: Versioned source snapshot and exact tool results before each claim; private simulator facts are not disclosed evidence. Education binding: explicitly supersede the previous constraint without claiming enrolment or verified eligibility. Review all turns and distinguish observed agent behaviour from missing evidence. Semantic disposition requires manual review; no human comprehension or release claim. Follow the latest stated attendance constraint without inferring verified attendance from Full-time, enrolment, qualification or eligibility.
